d: Gukesh is the reigning World Chess Champion, but as he prepares to defend his title against Javokhir Sindarov in Geneva, much of the chess world appears to be backing his challenger. Sindarov's rise, his World Cup and Candidates victories, the ratings gap and predictions from Magnus Carlsen and Hikaru Nakamura have made him the favourite. But Gukesh has already proved that expectations and predictions do not always decide a World Championship match. Rupha Ramani looks at the pressure on the young Indian grandmaster and whether he can silence the doubters once again.
